name: Gepirone
metabolism: CYP3A4 forms the pharmacologically active metabolites 1-PP and 3'-hydroxygepirone. Elimination occurs mainly through urine as metabolites, with a smaller fecal component.
summary: Gepirone is an oral medication used to treat major depressive disorder. It is an azapirone and a partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor.
